summary.text: Anthony DeSimone is a Democratic state representative from District 5 who took office on January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.

paragraphs.text: DeSimone lives in Providence, Rhode Island, and graduated from St.
Raphael Academy in Pawtucket, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working for the Providence Water Supply Board.
